Personnel training

FIB Academy.

A structured path from application through training to the start of service.

Training program

Training stages

Application

Submit an application for initial review.

Screening

Assessment of motivation, readiness and eligibility.

Invitation

Approved applicants receive an individual invitation to the next stage.

Initial training

Training in procedures, service standards and interdepartmental coordination.

Entry into service

Upon completion of training, personnel begin service in the general corps.

Specialization

Further development and eligibility for transfer to a specialized division.
